concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: insulated travel boots. A pair of chunky fur-lined travel boots standing side by side, touching, as one object. Warm brown leather with stitched seams and thick soles, big fluffy cream wool and fur cuffs folded over the tops, leather laces and a small brass buckle strap on each. Cosy, oversized, cartoonishly chunky proportions. About 0.35 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: pair of chunky brown leather boots side by side, big cream fleece cuffs, laces, olive strap with brass buckle; front, 3/4 and back views consistent
